A quick way to recognise the loop order of a diagram is to look at how many factors of (4π) appear in the denominator.  

• In four-dimensional dimensional regularisation a single loop integral
 ∫ d⁴k / (2π)⁴ …  
typically contributes a factor ≈ 1/(16π²) = 1/(4π)² after the dust settles.  
• Therefore each loop brings in one power (4π)² in the denominator.

If the overall coefficient is 1/(4π)⁶, then

(4π)⁶ = (4π)² × (4π)² × (4π)²  

so there must be three such factors, i.e. three independent loop integrals.

Hence the diagram must have contained 3 loops.

Answer: B
